name: 33026 · Pembroke Pnes, FL
findings: ZIP 33026 (Pembroke Pnes) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33026 (Pembroke Pnes) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
